claims.title: Decision-record schema structure
claims.proposition: The selected decision record satisfies the selected schema profile's structural rules that were executed.
doesNotEstablish: truth or completeness of cited evidence

claims.title: Declared cross-field consistency
claims.proposition: The selected decision record satisfies the v0.1 semantic conformance rules that were executed.
doesNotEstablish: truth or completeness of cited evidence

claims.title: Human or collective authority surface
claims.proposition: Non-pending decisions identify a permitted human/committee/DAO authority kind under the selected profile rules that were executed.
doesNotEstablish: institutional legitimacy outside the declared surface

claims.title: Evidence reference resolution
claims.proposition: Referenced evidence, evaluator, conflict, and delivery identifiers resolve within the decision record under the executed conformance rules.
doesNotEstablish: truth of cited evidence bytes or URIs
completeness of the underlying evidence set

claims.title: Conflict and recusal consistency
claims.proposition: Declared conflicts, recusals, and substitutions are internally consistent under the executed conformance rules.

claims.title: Challenge lifecycle consistency
claims.proposition: Challenge fields are internally consistent under the executed conformance rules.
doesNotEstablish: that a challenge process was adequate or used

claims.title: Delivery-condition consistency
claims.proposition: Delivery conditions required by the decision status are present and reference-consistent under the executed conformance rules.

claims.title: Source bytes match metadata
claims.proposition: Exact supplied source bytes match the declared content hash and length in the source-artifact metadata.
doesNotEstablish: truth or ownership of the source
adoption of the source by a program
independent capture-time authenticity beyond the supplied metadata

claims.title: Policy pin matches byte-verified artifact
claims.proposition: A policy pin matches an exact byte-verified source artifact by URI and hash under the executed pin checks.
doesNotEstablish: that the pinned policy is the only applicable policy

claims.title: Manifest binding (C1)
claims.proposition: Revealed manifest and salt reopen the commitment digest in the supplied envelope, and the manifest's programId, roundId, and applicationDeadline match that envelope.
doesNotEstablish: anchor validity, temporal precedence, execution, operator honesty, or evaluator correctness

claims.title: Temporal precedence (C2)
claims.proposition: Selected anchor profile places the envelope before the application deadline.
doesNotEstablish: universal time; the named profile's trust root and monitoring assumptions apply

claims.title: Round-envelope binding (C3)
claims.proposition: The verified anchor binds the public envelope's programId, roundId, applicationDeadline, commitment algorithm, and commitment digest as one anchored object.
doesNotEstablish: that an unopened manifest contains matching round fields; successful reveal or authorized audit is required for that check

claims.title: Run attribution (C4)
claims.proposition: Signer asserts this run used the bound commitment, input snapshots, environment, and output digest.
doesNotEstablish: that the signer actually used that configuration or that the output is sound
that the signing key is authorized by an external operator policy (see C4A)
claims.notes: C4 remains signature attribution to the supplied key. Authorization is C4A.

claims.title: Authorized run signer (C4A)
claims.proposition: The verified run signature key/identity is authorized by the external verifier trust policy for the declared operator role within the policy validity window.
doesNotEstablish: operator honesty or that the committed configuration was used
C4 signature attribution when no signature is present
claims.notes: New claim; does not silently strengthen historical C4.

claims.title: Replay evidence (C5)
claims.proposition: Accepted replay evidence records per-layer exact-match, diverged, or not-replayable outcomes from canonical artifact recomputation.
doesNotEstablish: re-execution of the recorded implementation unless separately demonstrated; fairness, legitimacy, hosted-model identity over time, or substantive merit

claims.title: Human authority separation (C6)
claims.proposition: No Phase II object populated decision.authorityKind.
doesNotEstablish: institutional approval, committee adoption, or funding authority

claims.title: Projection spec structure
claims.proposition: The projection specification is structurally valid under the selected projection profile.
doesNotEstablish: that the projection policy is socially adequate

claims.title: Deterministic projection execution
claims.proposition: Projection execution is deterministic for the supplied confidential source and projection specification under the selected profile.
doesNotEstablish: absence of dictionary attacks on low-entropy withheld fields

claims.title: Projection coverage completeness
claims.proposition: Every covered source field has a disposition under the selected projection version.

claims.title: Withheld subtree commitment
claims.proposition: Withheld commitments match the supplied confidential subtrees when those subtrees are available for verification under the selected projection version.
doesNotEstablish: secrecy against dictionary attack for low-entropy fields

claims.title: Projection integrity binding
claims.proposition: Projection integrity binds the exact specified inputs and outputs under its versioned construction and does not overwrite source integrity.
doesNotEstablish: institutional approval of the projection policy

claims.title: Corpus case contract
claims.proposition: The corpus case object is structurally valid under the corpus case schema and protocol rules that were executed.

claims.title: Corpus snapshot byte binding
claims.proposition: Exact record snapshot bytes match the declared SHA-256 hashes.

claims.title: Corpus validator finding binding
claims.proposition: Exact validator findings match the initial and final decision-record bytes under the corpus binding protocol.
doesNotEstablish: that unresolved findings are process gaps

claims.title: Redistributable source byte verification
claims.proposition: Source-artifact byte verification is claimed only for redistributable supplied bytes.

claims.title: Corpus metrics arithmetic
claims.proposition: Reported corpus metrics are arithmetically correct for the supplied case annotations and findings.

claims.title: Study-status machine gates
claims.proposition: Study-status machine gates are computed correctly against the predeclared study plan.
doesNotEstablish: that uncovered strata have no evidence anywhere
that ready-for-final-review means the research is complete

claims.title: Funding decision-status snapshot
claims.proposition: A dated decision-status snapshot matches the cited artifact set under the funding provenance rules that were executed.

claims.title: Financial evidence requires its own source
claims.proposition: Financial-evidence fields are populated only when their own evidence is supplied; allocation alone does not establish payment, receipt, or settlement.
doesNotEstablish: that unpaid means the event never occurred elsewhere

claims.title: Release commit identity
claims.proposition: The release artifact set identifies an exact repository commit.

claims.title: Release checks correspond to commit
claims.proposition: Required validation checks correspond to the exact published commit under the release integrity procedure that was executed.

claims.title: Attached archive digest
claims.proposition: The attached release archive digest matches the attached bytes under the release integrity procedure that was executed.
doesNotEstablish: that downstream mirrors remain unmodified forever

claims.title: SBOM pipeline claim boundary
claims.proposition: SBOM and attestation artifacts claim only what the build pipeline establishes for the exact published assets.

claims.title: External trust policy binding
claims.proposition: Trust-dependent checks used an externally supplied trust policy whose digest is recorded; the bundle did not appoint its own trust roots.
doesNotEstablish: correctness of the operator's trust choices
